const question = $json.question || "";

const query = `
MATCH (a:Actor)
WHERE 
  coalesce(a.is_canonical_actor, false) = true
  AND (
    toLower(coalesce(a.actor_role, "")) IN ["supplier", "manufacturer"]
    OR toLower(coalesce(a.display_name, a.actor_name, a.name, "")) CONTAINS "supplier"
    OR toLower(coalesce(a.display_name, a.actor_name, a.name, "")) CONTAINS "materials"
    OR toLower(coalesce(a.display_name, a.actor_name, a.name, "")) CONTAINS "manufacturing"
    OR toLower(coalesce(a.display_name, a.actor_name, a.name, "")) CONTAINS "cable"
    OR toLower(coalesce(a.display_name, a.actor_name, a.name, "")) CONTAINS "coating"
    OR EXISTS {
      MATCH (a)-[:SUPPLIES]-()
    }
  )
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r]-(connected)
RETURN 
  a.actor_id AS supplier_id,
  coalesce(a.display_name, a.actor_name, a.name) AS supplier_name,
  a.region AS region,
  a.actor_origin AS actor_origin,
  a.actor_role AS actor_role,
  labels(connected) AS connected_labels,
  coalesce(
    connected.display_name,
    connected.actor_name,
    connected.name,
    connected.unit_id,
    connected.process_id,
    connected.material_id,
    connected.location_name,
    connected.id
  ) AS connected_entity,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  properties(connected) AS connected_properties
ORDER BY supplier_id
LIMIT 100
`;

return [
  {
    json: {
      agent: "procurement_specialist",
      domain: "Procurement Specialist",
      question,
      query,
      params: {},
    },
  },
];
